exposure: trial of labor after cesarean delivery
cohort: 42,771 mothers with nonanomalous, term, singleton live births in California between 2010-2012 who had two prior cesarean deliveries and no clear contraindications for trial of labor
finding: Trial of labor after two prior cesarean deliveries was rarely attempted, successful in only 39.4% of attempts, and associated with a modest increase in severe neonatal morbidity but not severe maternal morbidity.
mod_finding: Among women with two prior cesarean deliveries, trial of labor was successful in 39.4% of attempts.
